about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Ilhan Omar

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Here is where the money goes: tens of billions of dollars for the Pentagon, billions more for the CIA to continue funding this illegal war with Trump, and billions to help States implement the SAVE Act, legislation that could make it harder for millions of eligible Americans to vote.
Meanwhile, working families are struggling to put food on the table and gas in their tanks, pay their rent, and afford healthcare.
Mr. Chair, I urge all Members to vote against it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Let me tell you what the money could mean for working families.
It could provide free childcare for over 1 million children for 2 years.
We could expand and extend the ACA premium tax credit for at least a year.
We could cancel the Medicare debt of a third of Americans.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to this reconciliation bill.
This is why I will be introducing a bill to redirect ICE's slush fund to the very communities that the agencies have terrorized and harmed.
Mr. Speaker, I won't support another dollar for ICE, and I urge my colleagues to vote against this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
sentences: Israeli officials have openly stated they seek to implement the Gaza model, but in Lebanon.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of this resolution because it is unconscionable for Congress to allow this conflict to go on.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' and refuse to enable another forever war.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to this Republican effort to funnel another $70 billion to ICE and CBP to continue their inhumane, illegal, and reprehensible actions.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: We are already seeing thousands of civilians killed and wounded in Iran and in Lebanon, American servicemembers lost, and millions forced from their homes with nowhere to go.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HANDS OFF CUBA
statements.title: HANDS OFF CUBA
sentences: Make no mistake, this unconscionable suffering is occurring because Trump is trying to force regime change.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MUHAMMAD ALI AMERICAN BOXING REVIVAL ACT OF 2026
statements.title: MUHAMMAD ALI AMERICAN BOXING REVIVAL ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Muhammad Ali American Boxing Revival Act.
I am voting ``yes'' today because boxers deserve those benefits and protections.
I support this bill, not because it is perfect, but because we fought hard to make sure it wasn't just a gift to industry.
Mr. Speaker, I urge Senators to keep improving this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Donald Trump is unilaterally dragging this Nation into an illegal and unjustified war with Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to support this resolution.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' to stop U.S. involvement in another illegal forever war.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
statements.title: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
sentences: We cannot allow a Federal agency--one that was created for the purpose of terrorizing--to function as an occupying force in our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMUNITIES DESERVE SAFETY
statements.title: COMMUNITIES DESERVE SAFETY
sentences: Let's be clear: What we are witnessing from ICE is not law enforcement.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH PRESIDENTIALLY DESIGNATED
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH PRESIDENTIALLY DESIGNATED TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS IN THE...
sentences: We also have the White House Chief of Staff on record saying that this is about regime change.
It risks driving us into further war in Venezuela.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of this resolution.
I was proud to co-lead Ranking Member Meeks' effort, and I urge all my colleagues to join us today in reasserting this body's constitutional authority on matters of war and peace.
We cannot allow this kind of dangerous overreach to go unchecked.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all my colleagues to uphold the separation of powers and pass this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP'S LABOR AGENDA: UNSAFE AND UNDERPAID
statements.title: TRUMP'S LABOR AGENDA: UNSAFE AND UNDERPAID
sentences: Millions of home healthcare workers could be paid below minimum wage and denied overtime protections, leaving them vulnerable to long hours and financial insecurity.
American workers are not disposable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VENEZUELA, FTOS, AND WAR POWERS
statements.title: VENEZUELA, FTOS, AND WAR POWERS
sentences: That is why I am introducing a resolution to terminate hostilities against Venezuela and against the transnational criminal organizations that the administration has designated as terrorists this year.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues, regardless of their party or ideology, to join me in this effort.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING ANNUNCIATION CATHOLIC SCHOOL
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING ANNUNCIATION CATHOLIC SCHOOL
sentences: An 8 year old and 10 year old lost their lives to senseless gun violence at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis last week.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RISK OF CONFLICT WITH NUCLEAR WEAPONS
statements.title: RISK OF CONFLICT WITH NUCLEAR WEAPONS
sentences: Nuclear-armed India exchanged fire with nuclear-armed Pakistan just this year.
Nuclear-armed Israel conducted unilateral strikes on facilities in Iran.
Nuclear-armed Russia continues its brutal war of conquest in Ukraine.
In a few short weeks we will mark the 80th anniversary of the only time nuclear weapons have been used in combat by the United States in Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Japan.
Either we will abolish these horrific weapons from the face of the Earth, or we will use them and abolish humanity instead.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING THE ATTACKS ON MINNESOTA LAWMAKERS IN BROOKLYN PARK AND CHAMPLIN, MINNESOTA, AND CALLING FOR UNITY AND THE REJECTION OF POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN MINNESOTA A
statements.title: CONDEMNING THE ATTACKS ON MINNESOTA LAWMAKERS IN BROOKLYN PARK AND CHAMPLIN, MINNESOTA, AND CALLING FOR UNITY AND THE REJECTION OF POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN MINNESOTA AND ACROSS THE UNITED STATES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE, SURVEILLANCE, AND TRUMP
statements.title: ICE, SURVEILLANCE, AND TRUMP
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to denounce the Trump administration's police state tactics in Minneapolis, Los Angeles, New York City, and so many other cities across the country.
I wonder, when the Federal Government is sending marines to break up protests in Los Angeles, why are we hearing little from that side about the States' rights.

One of them said: ``It is just made to instill fear, and I am not sure why we need fear in our communities instead of love and caring and community.'' That is what we are about in this country, and that is what we will continue to stand up for. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: Just last month, numerous Members and Cabinet officials profited off of Donald Trump's tariff chaos announcement.
It is time we come together to stop this corruption and pass an immediate stock trading ban.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
statements.title: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
sentences: Just weeks ago, the Trump administration defied a unanimous--we didn't think this was possible--but a unanimous Supreme Court order by refusing to facilitate the return of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Maryland father wrongfully deported to a notorious prison in El Salvador.
We must ask ourselves: If the rights of noncitizens can be so easily disregarded, whose rights will be next?
If the government can silence you, detain you, or deport you while defying court orders, then none of our rights are safe.
What we are seeing is authoritarianism creeping in through the backdoor, one ignored ruling at a time.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this budget resolution isn't about fiscal responsibility.
It is about gutting Medicaid and SNAP so that the rich can continue to hoard more tax breaks.
President Trump is firing public servants, slashing critical programs, and enacting chaotic tariffs that will raise costs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: They want to increase your healthcare costs while Elon Musk and his friends hoard even more wealth, and they have the audacity to call it fiscal responsibility.

This proposal will only deepen the constitutional crisis we are already in: a President trying to rule like a dictator and an unelected billionaire using hate and fear to expand his control over our country.

Our government is being hollowed out, our institutions are falling apart, and today House Republicans are slashing programs that people rely on to enact a massive $4.6 trillion tax giveaway to the rich.
So I ask my Republican colleagues: Whom will you serve, the people who sent you here or the billionaires trying to buy our democracy?
Mr. Chairman, I rise in strong opposition to this Republican budget resolution because it is not a budget.
